officialDecision.title: Vedtak av statlig reguleringsplan for nytt regjeringskvartal

documentedPlanScope.additionalIncludedObject: Regjeringsbygget R5 på vestsiden av Akersgata

crosscheckDecision.reason: The official state decision defines Regjeringskvartalet as the same combined institutional area represented by the single Oslo Planinnsyn S-5100 polygon. The municipal polygon supplies machine-traceable geometry; the state decision supplies authoritative identity and physical scope.
productionConditions: live WFS must still return exactly one PLANID 202020172 / S-5100 / PLANTYPE 34 Polygon
live geometry must match the merged post-193 research within the locked drift tolerance
canonical parent/subplace overlaps must be explicit and no unexpected coordinate collision may be introduced

verification.note: The official government HTML and PDF were independently checked outside GitHub Actions. The origin blocks GitHub-hosted Actions requests with HTTP 403, so production must hard-gate this merged research contract and revalidate the official Oslo WFS geometry live rather than substituting a proxy or cached third-party page.
